This packet supplies (a) and (b); (c) is governor's own run of a_a19_mutate_v2.py; (d) is verifier's review. verifier performs no removal and certifies nothing beyond static and intact evidence.
changes.note: Per-boundary sites: the PostgreSQL receiver keeps its own signature, exact-bytes, epoch-fence, deadline, nonce and budget sites, and the governance target its own nonce claim and budget participant; v2 removals target each.

Lock entry uses ExitStack: a failure after acquiring the connection or entering the transaction unwinds both and re-raises the original exception. Verified with an ordinary synthetic statement failure.

Each of E, H and P calls its gate's public authorize_release. No approval, no policy and no evidence each refuse there with no permit, nonce unspent and nothing written. The policy and evidence cases carry a completed approval. The engine-level matrix (test_bf1_deny_by_default_matrix_pg.py) and the unchanged VerticalSpec proof stay.

binding_map.review: Settlements are keyed by (tenant, review_id), and a nonce settles under one review only (constraint settlement_nonce_once). Naming a settled nonce under another review refuses: test_a_settled_nonce_named_under_another_review_is_refused. A different review with its own nonce is a separate approved review, not a re-entry.
binding_map.bytes: artifact digest and contract digest are in the binding digest: test_reentry_with_a_changed_binding_is_refused[artifact], [contract].
binding_map.target: target digest and operation are in the binding: [out_path].
binding_map.permit: Not caller-supplied: re-entry never accepts a permit. The retained permit is re-authenticated (TargetAuthority.authenticate, decision envelope verify_entry, record-hash, principal and tenant binding) before it is returned: test_settle_once_reenter_same_permit_commit_once_and_observe (same signed permit). A retained body altered at rest is not exercised (no tamper probe is authored); its refusal rests on that re-authentication.
binding_map.budget_reservation: Not caller-supplied: the reservation id is the permit's, bound to the nonce at issuance. Re-entry returns the same permit and its live reservation; the reserve count stays 1 across re-entry and every refused change (_reservations == 1).

changes.note: Renamed to the injected-error claim it proves (effect-applied-connection-error-injected) with an explicit limit: not a severed or terminated transport.

Windows050 failure (verifier 4e66c55b): the second same-tenant admission was cancelled (QueryCanceled -> UNKNOWN) at the unchanged 30 s production lane lock_timeout, because the test held the first admission until the other tenant's whole admission completed under full-suite load. The test now releases as soon as it observes, within OBSERVE_S=20 < 30 s, both the same-tenant lane waiter and the other tenant inside its own callback; the paused hold is 120 s. Production deadline unchanged; waiter, order, status and decision-time assertions unchanged (the other tenant's completion is asserted after release).
